sentences.text:
MR ASHRAF R GHOGHARI(10613) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR EKANT G AHUJA(5323) for the Respondent(s) No. 1  MS VRUNDA SHAH, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SAMIR J. DAVE  Date : 11/10/2024  ORAL ORDER 1.
Earlier reasoned order was passed by this Court on 16.01.2023.
Subsequently, the very order was challenged by the present applicant before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and the Hon'ble Supreme Court has passed the following order on 02.02.2024:
"It is not in dispute that, as recorded in the earlier order, one of the two petitioners applied before the High Court for interim bail and was granted interim bail.

In the application for bail, it is stated that there is no application for bail pending in the Mohammadhasnain Mohammad Haroon Luhar vs State Of Gujarat on 11 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59142097/
1 High Court or in this Court.

entities.text: Mohammadhasnain Mohammad Haroon Luhar vs State Of Gujarat on 11 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Moreover, even the other petitioner applied for temporary bail before the Trial Court.

These facts were not disclosed to the advocate for the petitioners by the petitioners and therefore, these facts were never brought to the notice of the Court on 23 rd January, 2024 when these petitions were listed before this Court.
The petitioners have tendered apology for the said conduct.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18020/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/10/2024 undefined
We dispose of these Special Leave Petitions by granting liberty to the petitioners to make a fresh application for grant of bail before the Trial Court.

As the petitioners have tendered apology for their conduct, the acts of the petitioners of filing applications, as aforesaid, shall not come in the way of the petitioners for consideration of the prayer for bail, if they are otherwise entitled to bail.
We are sure that if a fresh application is made, the Trial Court will decide the same on its own merits and as expeditiously as possible.
The Court will also consider the period of custody of the petitioners and the fact that charge sheet has been filed.
Subject to what is observed above, all contentions are left open.
The Special Leave Petitions are disposed of in terms aforesaid.
Pending applications also stand disposed of."
2. The offences registered under sections 409, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 506(1) and 114 of IPC with DCB Police Station, Ahmedabad City on 12.09.2022.
It reflects from the investigation papers that number of persons were being cheated by the present applicant.

3. Heard learned advocate for the applicant, learned APP and also perused the material on record,
including the charge- sheet papers.

Before the trial Court, several members, who had invested huge amounts for purchasing flats in the residential scheme in question, had filed written objections against the regular bail application filed by the applicant.

The gist of such objection applications filed by the members is that they have paid huge amounts in NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18020/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/10/2024 undefined cash / cheque, running in Lacs, to the Construction Firm belonging to the applicant and in lieu thereof, the applicant had also issued Receipts.
4.

This Court is aware that all the offences which are registered are triable by the learned Magistrate,
but looking to the seriousness of the offences, this Court is not inclined to entertain the present successive bail application of the applicant.
This Court does not find this to be a fit case, where the applicant deserves to be enlarged on regular bail.
In the result, present application stands rejected.
The Trial Court is directed to conclude the trial preferably within a period of 9 months from the date of this order.

(SAMIR J. DAVE,J) MEHUL B. TUVAR Mohammadhasnain Mohammad Haroon Luhar vs State Of Gujarat on 11 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59142097/
